issues.issue: The mITT analysis population numbers (placebo 121, 8 mg 133, 12 mg 133) are stated but the randomized citation shows 12 mg as 134; the '12 mg 133' mITT figure is only supported by the result-table header, not a distinct mITT breakdown, and the text conflates randomized vs mITT numbers without full citation support.

Internal inconsistency: the 8 mg arm shows -30.5 vs placebo -9.7 (p=0.0008) while the 12 mg arm shows only -17.6 (p=.01), i.e. the lower dose outperformed the higher dose — this anomalous/likely-mislabeled result is presented without any caveat and should be verified.
Result-table citation for Study 306 shows placebo N=184, but the n field reports placebo 185 (randomized); the mITT/analysis N of 184 is uncited in the n text.

Dizziness rates are attributed to dose columns as '16% (4 mg), 32% (8 mg), 43% (12 mg)' but the citation header lists columns Placebo/4 mg/8 mg/12 mg with the row '9 16 32 43'; the mapping is plausible but the text labels '4 mg=16%' etc. should be checked — more importantly '43% (12 mg)' and the column Ns (n=442/172/431/255) differ from the pivotal trial populations, indicating a pooled safety dataset not clearly identified.

Citation quote states 'NDA dated December 22, 2012, received December 22, 2012' but the summary text and receipt_date say received 12/22/11; the cited quote contradicts the stated receipt year (the quote appears to contain an OCR/typo error being relied upon).

priority_review.present=false is unsupported; the review shows a standard ~10-month review (received 12/22/11, PDUFA/approval 10/22/2012) consistent with standard review, but the designation status is asserted without any citation confirming it was a standard (non-priority) review.
